source: Acknowledge/accept-or-deny/pay timelines for the states below are drawn from published summaries of each state's unfair claims settlement practices rules as of 2026. All other states show the general model most states follow (based on the NAIC Unfair Claims Settlement Practices Act). Insurance regulations change and exact wording varies by state — confirm with your state department of insurance before relying on a specific number of days.

default.decide: Around 15-40 days after you submit a complete proof of loss is typical.
default.pay: Around 5-30 days after you accept a settlement is typical.

CA.name: California
CA.decide: 40 calendar days after proof of loss
CA.pay: 30 calendar days after settlement is reached

TX.name: Texas
TX.decide: 15 business days after receiving all requested information
TX.pay: 5 business days after you accept a settlement offer

FL.name: Florida
FL.decide: 90 days to pay or deny (combined timeline)

NY.name: New York
NY.decide: 15 business days after a properly executed proof of loss
NY.pay: 15 business days after the claim is settled

GA.name: Georgia
GA.pay: 10 days after agreement or final judgment

IL.name: Illinois
IL.decide: 30 days after receiving proof of loss
IL.pay: 30 days after reaching an agreement or settlement

PA.name: Pennsylvania
PA.decide: 15 working days after receiving all requested documentation
PA.pay: 10 working days after agreement or settlement

NC.name: North Carolina
NC.decide: 30 days after receiving all relevant documents
NC.pay: 10 business days after acceptance or final settlement

OH.name: Ohio
OH.decide: 21 days after receiving proof of loss

AZ.name: Arizona
AZ.decide: 30 days after receiving proof of loss
AZ.pay: 30 days after settlement or final decision
